MRK.headline: Merck Healthcare and JD Health Announce Strategic Partnership
MRK.summary: Merck Healthcare and JD Health have entered into a strategic partnership to prioritize the online launch of new drugs on the JD Health platform over the next three years.

MRK.headline: Moderna Stuns Wall Street With Surprise Profit, Raises Outlook
MRK.summary: Moderna (MRNA) jumps as Q3 earnings swing to a surprise profit of $0.38/share on strong global vaccine sales and cost cuts.

MRK.headline: Growth Lead Sectors In Friday Trading As Defensives Trail
MRK.summary: Seven sectors are higher and four are lower in Friday’s regular session, with growth sectors holding the top three positions. The leaders are separated rather than clustered, with no single gap clearly standing apart from the other breaks across the table.

MRK.headline: 'US Measles Cases Top 5,000 for the First Time Since the 1990s' - Bloomberg
Merck Deepens Strategic Partnership with JD Health to Expand Access to Innovative Medicines in China
MRK.summary: Merck and JD Health have announced an expanded collaboration to accelerate the availability of innovative drugs for patients across China through digital health channels.

MRK.headline: Merck & Co., Inc. Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
MRK.summary: Merck & Co., Inc. reported third-quarter 2026 sales of $18.09 billion, representing a 4.7% year-over-year increase, alongside updates on product approvals and acquisitions.

MRK.headline: RBC Capital Markets Updates Forecasts Following Lonza's Acquisition of Merck KGaA Sites
MRK.summary: RBC Capital Markets has updated its financial forecasts for Lonza following the company's acquisition of five contract manufacturing sites from Merck KGaA.

MRK.headline: Daiwa Securities Adjusts Merck & Co. Price Target
MRK.summary: Daiwa Securities has revised its price target for Merck & Co., Inc. from $143 to $160.

MRK.headline: Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany Hosts Change Chemistry European Forum
MRK.summary: Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, hosted the 2026 European Forum for the nonprofit organization Change Chemistry at its global headquarters.

MRK.headline: Merck Updates 2026 Financial Guidance
MRK.summary: Merck & Co., Inc. has revised its full-year 2026 financial outlook, increasing its worldwide sales and non-GAAP EPS guidance.

MRK.headline: FDA Grants Emergency Use Authorization for Merck's Bravecto
MRK.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has issued an emergency use authorization for Merck's Bravecto to treat screwworm infestations in dogs.

MRK.headline: Merck Supports American Lung Association's New Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension (PAH) Resources
MRK.summary: Merck is supporting the American Lung Association in launching new educational resources and support services for the pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) community.

MRK.headline: FDA Issues Emergency Use Authorization For Drug To Treat New World Screwworm Infestations In Dogs, Puppies
Analysts Update Ratings and Price Targets for Merck & Co., Inc.
MRK.summary: Several financial institutions, including Leerink Partners and Cantor Fitzgerald, have updated their ratings and price targets for Merck & Co., Inc. (MRK) as of November 3, 2026.

MRK.headline: Merck Initiates Phase 3 ENHANCE-3 Clinical Trial for OHTUVAYRE in COPD Patients
MRK.summary: Merck has launched the ENHANCE-3 Phase 3 clinical trial to evaluate the efficacy of OHTUVAYRE (ensifentrine) in preventing COPD exacerbations among adult patients receiving standard care.

MRK.headline: Merck Initiates Its ENHANCE-3 Phase 3 Randomized Clinical Trial Evaluating OHTUVAYRE For The Prevention Of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
Merck KGaA to Divest CDMO Business to Lonza
MRK.summary: Merck KGaA, Darmstadt, Germany, has signed a definitive agreement to divest its contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) business to Lonza for a mid-triple-digit million-euro amount.

MRK.headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Adjusts Price Target on Merck & Co., Inc.
MRK.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald has increased its price target for Merck & Co., Inc. from $145 to $155.

MRK.headline: Merck to Present New Data from Its Oral HIV Portfolio at HIV Glasgow 2026
MRK.summary: Merck & Co., Inc. announced it will present new Phase 3 subgroup analyses and patient-reported outcomes for its investigational once-weekly oral HIV combination therapy at the HIV Glasgow 2026 conference.
